$comment: Every UI-contract violation the product deliberately keeps, and why. `npm run check:ui-contract` fails on anything not listed here, on a count higher OR lower than recorded, and on any entry whose rule has no `reasons` text. This began as a shrink-only inventory of 660 violations carrying `debt` tags for the migration slices that owed the work; that debt reached zero on 2026-08-25 and the `debt` escape hatch was removed with it. An entry here is now a decision someone wrote down, not a promise to come back. Regenerate with `npm run check:ui-contract -- --update`.

reasons.raw-table: DataTable is the approved display-table contract. The rule exists to send feature code here; this is here.

reasons.raw-hex-colour: roadmap §5 — the hero's background wash is brand artwork: three decorative blobs blurred over 256–384px, aria-hidden, carrying no information, drawn in the mark's own colours. The named brand roles (--ds-color-brand-accent / -primary) cover everything on that panel that carries meaning; these three are translucent, and a Tailwind opacity modifier cannot be applied to a var() colour, so tokenising them would mean three single-use tint tokens for a blur.

reasons.raw-table: roadmap §5 — approved native-table pattern for an editable matrix or per-row interactive rows. DataTable is a display-table contract. The table must still use the --ds-table-* roles.
roadmap §5 — approved native-table pattern for an editable matrix or per-row interactive rows. DataTable is a display-table contract. The table must still use the --ds-table-* roles.

reasons.raw-palette-class: roadmap §5 — DeviceMockup is artwork, not interface. The bezel, side buttons and battery pips are moulded plastic, not a SafeHaul surface; mapping them onto --ds-color-surface-inverse-subtle would look identical today and would mean re-tuning the console surface silently restyles a picture of a phone. Declared once in the DEVICE constant at the top of the file. The screen itself takes --ds-color-surface.
reasons.sub-12px-type: roadmap §5 — the phone status-bar time is a decorative illustration of a real device, not interface text.
reasons.tailwind-radius: roadmap §5 — device artwork. The bezel and side-button radii describe a moulded plastic case, not a SafeHaul surface, and they are part of the same DEVICE palette exception as its colours.

reasons.arbitrary-type-size: roadmap §5 — the 13px release-authorisation paragraph inside the generated 49 CFR §391.23 document. Same immutable export as this file's other entries: html2canvas rasterises it into a bare print window with no --ds-* properties, and VOEPreviewModal.export.test.jsx fails if the document acquires a token.
reasons.raw-palette-class: roadmap §5 — the generated 49 CFR §391.23 document is rasterised by html2canvas into a bare print window with no --ds-* custom properties, so a token would resolve to nothing. VOEPreviewModal.export.test.jsx enforces the boundary in both directions.
reasons.sub-12px-type: roadmap §5 — printed-form facsimile small print, not interface text.
reasons.tailwind-radius: roadmap §5 — the generated 49 CFR §391.23 document is rasterised by html2canvas into a bare print window with no --ds-* custom properties, so a tokenised radius would resolve to nothing on export. Enforced in both directions by VOEPreviewModal.export.test.jsx.
reasons.tailwind-shadow: roadmap §5 — the generated 49 CFR §391.23 document is rasterised by html2canvas into a bare print window with no --ds-* custom properties, so a tokenised shadow would resolve to nothing on export. Enforced in both directions by VOEPreviewModal.export.test.jsx.

reasons.hand-styled-button: roadmap §5 — an ARIA combobox option must carry role="option" inside the listbox, and `Button` renders role="button", which would break the combobox contract. No Combobox/Listbox primitive exists yet.

reasons.hand-built-overlay: roadmap §5 — `fixed inset-0` here is a positioning canvas, not a dialog backdrop: the layer is pointer-events-none and exists so a coach mark can be placed against a page element's coordinates. `Modal` centres and traps focus, which is the opposite of what a coach mark attached to a toolbar button needs. The one centred step does dim the page; that step's dialog semantics are recorded as an open item rather than claimed here.

reasons.raw-hex-colour: roadmap §5 — #1877F2 is Facebook's brand blue on the Facebook connection tile. A third-party mark is not a SafeHaul role and must not be re-tuned by a change to this product's palette, so it stays literal, the same way the SafeHaul mark's own colours are pinned rather than derived.

reasons.raw-table: roadmap §5 — approved native-table pattern for an editable matrix or per-row interactive rows. DataTable is a display-table contract. The table must still use the --ds-table-* roles.

reasons.hand-styled-button: roadmap §5 — two ~14px accept/reject badges pinned to the corners of a suggestion box whose minimum size is 8px; `IconButton`'s min-height would overflow it. Both keep an accessible name, a focus-visible ring and --ds-* tones. Retiring them needs a compact icon-button size in the design system.

roadmap §5 — the field-palette tiles are colour-coded per field type, which is domain-to-visual mapping the feature owns and `Button` has no API for. Same exception family as the PEV FMCSA suggestion rows and the call-outcome grid: no approved SelectableCard/Listbox primitive yet.

reasons.hand-styled-field: roadmap §5 — the inline field-label editor sits inside the draggable field rectangle, whose minimum size is 8px. The approved `Input`'s control height would overflow the box it is labelling. Same exception family as this file's corner remove badge.

roadmap §5 — these inputs overlay author-placed PDF field boxes, whose geometry comes from the document's own coordinates and can be as small as 8px. The approved controls carry the shared 36/44/52px control height and inline padding, which would break alignment with the PDF. Same constraint already recorded for the signature button in this file.
reasons.off-scale-type: roadmap §6 — `text-base` is the 16px iOS no-zoom idiom: Safari zooms the viewport when a focused input is under 16px and does not zoom back out. The design system does not solve this for `.ds-form-control` yet, so this file works around it locally. Recorded as an open item; when the design system fixes it product-wide, this comes out.

reasons.raw-table: roadmap §5 — approved native-table pattern for an editable matrix or per-row interactive rows. DataTable is a display-table contract. The table must still use the --ds-table-* roles.
roadmap §5 — approved native-table pattern for an editable matrix or per-row interactive rows. DataTable is a display-table contract. The table must still use the --ds-table-* roles.
roadmap §5 — an operator console with six per-row actions and live progress. Uses the --ds-table-* roles. Per-row interactive rows are the case §5 approves a native table for.

roadmap §5 — a native table inside a virtualised scroll region. Uses the --ds-table-* roles. DataTable owns its own scroll container, so adopting it here would mean nesting two, which is the defect that produces a dead scrollbar gutter.
roadmap §5 — approved native-table pattern for an editable matrix or per-row interactive rows. DataTable is a display-table contract. The table must still use the --ds-table-* roles.

roadmap §5 — a native table with a per-row filter control and a per-row action, inside a dialog. Uses the --ds-table-* roles. Converting it to DataTable would need the editable-matrix decision that §6 still records as open.

roadmap §5 — three native tables with per-row actions. They use the --ds-table-* roles for header, divider and density, so they follow the approved table contract visually; DataTable is a display-table contract and does not cover per-row actions in three linked tables sharing one scroll region.

reasons.hand-styled-anchor: A status-tinted phone chip that is also a tel: link. Fully tokenised with a screen-reader prefix ("Call now:"). Neither Link (underlined text) nor ButtonLink (button-shaped) is a tinted inline chip. See the tinted-chip-link gap in §5.

reasons.hand-styled-button: A selectable company row, not a button. It is correctly a <button> (it is a real activation), uses only --ds-* tokens and the shared focus ring. The rule cannot distinguish a tokenised selectable row from a hand-built button; forcing it into Button would make a list row look like an action bar.

reasons.hand-styled-field: Two inline numeric goal editors inside a labelled chip. Both are already tokenised, carry an aria-label and aria-invalid, and use the shared focus ring. `Input` is a 44px bordered full-width control and would destroy the compact inline chip; overriding it back would be worse than this. See the inline-editable-value gap in §5.

reasons.raw-table: roadmap §5 — approved native-table pattern for an editable matrix or per-row interactive rows. DataTable is a display-table contract. The table must still use the --ds-table-* roles.

reasons.raw-hex-colour: A print stylesheet, injected as a string into a bare print window that has no --ds-* custom properties — the same class of exception as the VOE export document. A token here would resolve to nothing and the page would print with no background.
